[[File:Proton_cannon.png|thumb|250px|A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannon]], armed with flak shells.]]
'''Flak''' was a projectile-based weapons system, usually ground-based, that was used against attacking airborne craft. [[All Terrain Anti Aircraft/Legends|AT-AAs]] used flak systems, as did [[Flak gun/Legends|flak guns]] aboard various [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The shells could use either proximity or timed fuses and exploded with showers of shrapnel. They could be highly dangerous to enemy combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] or [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], but much less so against other, larger classes of fighting ships. They were often used as a point-defense weapon.
